reviews.reason: Accept ScaleCameraData. The complete body multiplies each of six scalar components into the output. It assigns no field meaning beyond camera data.

Accept InitCameraBox as initialization or reseeding of an existing CmSubject, not allocation or first-use-only setup. It activates state, computes horizontal and vertical target extents, copies both into current extents, and seeds pos and bone_pos. The scaling caller in ft_0D27.c:27-33 proves reuse after a scale change. The source comment describes only the position-copy part and does not supersede body evidence.

Accept UpdateCameraBonePosition. This wrapper passes the existing subject bone_pos address to the same helper labeled Fighter_GetCameraBonePos in the canonical full updater at lines 85-86. No other field is explicitly written in this wrapper.

Accept UpdateDeadUpCameraBox. It calls the full updater, scales pos.x by camera-top distance divided by blast-top distance from stage center, asserts the denominator is nonzero, and places pos.y at blast-zone top. DeadUpStar_Cam and DeadUpFall_Cam callers confirm the DeadUp scope. The function does not change pos.z after the ordinary update.

canonical_api.semantics: Refreshes horizontal target extents, facing_dir and position from scaled fighter camera data; clears on_ledge; obtains bone_pos through ftLib_800866DC. It does not set Active state, vertical target extents, or current extents.

limitations: No new alias proposed. These are hypotheses, not attested original names.
Foreign references were read with git show at the pinned revision, canonical only. Foreign file ownership/coverage is not claimed.
The ftLib range 415-445 did not contain the requested camera helper; no helper-implementation conclusion is drawn from that range.
